sentences.en: I'm Gilbert Cruz and this is the Sunday Special.
sentences.zh: 我是吉尔伯特·克鲁兹，这是《周日特刊》。

sentences.en: There was a time when documentaries could only be found on public television and maybe at your local art house theater.
sentences.zh: 曾几何时，纪录片只能在公共电视台或当地艺术影院看到。

sentences.en: But today if you fire up almost any streaming service, you'll find that they're chock full of documentaries.
sentences.zh: 但今天，如果你打开几乎任何流媒体服务，你会发现它们到处都是纪录片。

sentences.en: True crime documentaries, celebrity documentaries, music documentaries, poop cruise documentaries.
sentences.zh: 真实犯罪纪录片、名人纪录片、音乐纪录片、粪便游轮纪录片。

sentences.en: Maybe there's just the one poop cruise documentary.
sentences.zh: 也许只有那一部粪便游轮纪录片。

sentences.en: Today we're going to talk about it all.
sentences.zh: 今天我们要谈谈这一切。

sentences.en: We're talking about documentaries.
sentences.zh: 我们正在谈论纪录片。

sentences.en: And if we're talking about docs, even in this era of incredible glut, there's one gentleman we have to talk about.
sentences.zh: 如果我们谈论纪录片，即使在这个内容过剩的时代，也有一位绅士是我们必须谈论的。

sentences.en: And that is Ken Burns.
sentences.zh: 那就是肯·伯恩斯。

sentences.en: He has made more than 40 documentaries.
sentences.zh: 他制作了40多部纪录片。

sentences.en: He's done jazz, which is the first one that I saw, baseball, the Civil War, country music, and so many other subjects.
sentences.zh: 他拍过爵士乐——这是我看到的第一部——还有棒球、内战、乡村音乐以及许多其他主题。

sentences.en: This month he's got a new one out, a six-part, 12-hour opus called
sentences.zh: 这个月他推出了一部新作，一部六集、时长12小时的巨作，名为

sentences.en: The American Revolution.
sentences.zh: 《美国革命》。

sentences.en: Here to talk about Ken Burns and the wide, wide world of docs,
sentences.zh: 今天来到这里与我们探讨肯·伯恩斯和广阔的纪录片世界的，

sentences.en: I've got two of my wonderful colleagues.
sentences.zh: 是我两位出色的同事。

sentences.en: Alyssa Wilkinson is a movie critic at the Times.
sentences.zh: 艾丽莎·威尔金森是《时报》的影评人。

sentences.en: She writes our documentary Lens column about new documentaries.
sentences.zh: 她负责撰写我们关于新纪录片的“纪录片镜头”专栏。

sentences.en: Hello, Alyssa.
sentences.zh: 你好，艾丽莎。

sentences.en: Hello.
sentences.zh: 你好。

sentences.en: And James Ponowazik is our chief TV critic.
sentences.zh: 詹姆斯·波诺瓦齐克是我们首席电视评论员。

sentences.en: He needs no introduction.
sentences.zh: 他无需介绍。

sentences.en: He has reviewed The American Revolution for us.
sentences.zh: 他为我们评论了《美国革命》。

sentences.en: Hello, Jim.
sentences.zh: 你好，吉姆。

sentences.en: Good day to you, sir.
sentences.zh: 你好，先生。

sentences.en: Good day.
sentences.zh: 你好。

sentences.en: Well, let's start with The American Revolution.
sentences.zh: 好吧，让我们从《美国革命》开始吧。

sentences.en: It's a great place to start.
sentences.zh: 这是一个很好的切入点。

sentences.en: America started there.
sentences.zh: 美国就是从那里开始的。

sentences.en: Why not us?
sentences.zh: 为什么我们不呢？

sentences.en: This one is directed by Burns, as well as his co-director,
sentences.zh: 这部作品由伯恩斯执导，以及他的联合导演，

sentences.en: Sarah Botstein and David Schmidt.
sentences.zh: 莎拉·博特斯坦和大卫·施密特。

sentences.en: Jim, tell us about this new one.
sentences.zh: 吉姆，给我们介绍一下这部新作吧。

sentences.en: So, The American Revolution is sort of what you would expect from your experience of Ken Burns, the celebrity guest voices, the sort of assembled roster of historians
sentences.zh: 《美国革命》基本上就是你从肯·伯恩斯过往作品中期待的那样，有名人嘉宾配音，还有一群历史学家

sentences.en: commenting on the historical events and their context.
sentences.zh: 对历史事件及其背景进行评论。

sentences.en: All the tricks he's developed to bring history to life, make it more kinetic, make it more auditory.
sentences.zh: 他运用了所有让历史鲜活起来的技巧，使其更具动感，更具听觉冲击力。

sentences.en: But it is also, you know, I would say, not just the version of the American Revolution that you learned in grade school, depending when you went to grade school.
sentences.zh: 但我也想说，这不仅仅是你小学时学到的那个版本的美国革命，具体取决于你什么时候上小学。

sentences.en: Right up front, you were sort of set at the beginning of the stirrings of revolution.
sentences.zh: 一开始，你就被带到了革命萌芽的初期。

sentences.en: From a small spark kindled in America, a flame has arisen, not to be extinguished.
sentences.zh: 从美国点燃的一点小火花，燃起了熊熊烈火，永不熄灭。

sentences.en: But the narrative also turns to the Iroquois Confederacy, which was a democratic governance arrangement among Native American groups
sentences.zh: 但叙事也转向了易洛魁联盟，这是一个在美洲原住民群体之间的民主治理安排，

sentences.en: that predated the American Revolution by centuries.
sentences.zh: 比美国革命早了几个世纪。

sentences.en: We know our lands are now become more valuable.
sentences.zh: 我们知道我们的土地现在变得更有价值了。

sentences.en: The white people think we do not know their value.
sentences.zh: 白人认为我们不知道它们的价值。

sentences.en: But we are sensible that the land is everlasting.
sentences.zh: 但我们深知土地是永恒的。

sentences.en: So it makes clear that this is going to be a story of all the Americans.
sentences.zh: 所以它清楚地表明，这将是一个关于所有美国人的故事。

sentences.en: Colonists, loyalists, yes, but also Native Americans, also enslaved Americans.
sentences.zh: 殖民者、效忠派，当然，还有美洲原住民，以及被奴役的美国人。

sentences.en: To that extent, I think it is a broadening of the story.
sentences.zh: 在这一点上，我认为这是对故事的拓展。

sentences.en: And at 12 hours, he's got a lot of space to broaden the story.
sentences.zh: 而且在12小时的篇幅里，他有足够的空间来拓展这个故事。

sentences.en: I would say that it's not one of his most surprising documentaries in terms of departing from his style.
sentences.zh: 我想说，就偏离他的风格而言，这并不是他最令人惊讶的纪录片之一。

sentences.en: But with the 250th anniversary of America's independence coming up and a lot of culture wars going on over America's history
sentences.zh: 但随着美国独立250周年纪念日的临近，以及围绕美国历史的文化战争愈演愈烈，

sentences.en: and how it's told and what people should and shouldn't say about it,
sentences.zh: 关于历史该如何讲述，人们该说什么、不该说什么，

sentences.en: there were certainly things that surprised me.
sentences.zh: 确实有一些东西让我感到惊讶。

sentences.en: Things like, one of the takeaways that I got from this was George Washington, you know, a great American figure,
sentences.zh: 比如，我从中得到的一个收获是乔治·华盛顿，你知道，一位伟大的美国人物，

sentences.en: not necessarily a great general in terms of winning a lot of battles.
sentences.zh: 在赢得许多战役方面，他不一定是一位伟大的将军。

sentences.en: Well, if you remember the musical Hamilton,
sentences.zh: 嗯，如果你还记得音乐剧《汉密尔顿》，

sentences.en: I think there is a line that he says there about having lost his first battle or something of that sort.
sentences.zh: 我想里面有一句台词提到他输掉了第一场战斗之类的。

sentences.en: Yeah, you know, I need it wrapped at me a few times before I really retain it.
sentences.zh: 是啊，你知道，我得听好几次才能真正记住。

sentences.en: I'm not going to do that here.
sentences.zh: 我在这里就不复述了。

sentences.en: Alyssa, what's your relationship to the work of Mr. Ken Burns?
sentences.zh: 艾丽莎，你和肯·伯恩斯先生的作品有什么渊源吗？

sentences.en: So, I wasn't a big TV watcher as a kid, but I was a big PBS TV watcher as a kid.
sentences.zh: 我小时候不是个电视迷，但我小时候是个PBS（公共电视网）的忠实观众。

sentences.en: And my main memory of watching PBS as a kid is watching Ken Burns' documentaries during pledge drives.
sentences.zh: 我小时候看PBS的主要记忆就是在募捐活动期间看肯·伯恩斯的纪录片。

sentences.en: I don't know which ones they were.
sentences.zh: 我不知道具体是哪几部。

sentences.en: Looking at the dates, I'm thinking it was possibly the Civil War or maybe the Congress.
sentences.zh: 看看日期，我想可能是《内战》或者《国会》。

sentences.en: Although, I think I also was watching the Shakers.
sentences.zh: 虽然，我想我也看过《震教徒》。

sentences.en: I think they just used to run them during pledge drives.
sentences.zh: 我想他们过去常在募捐活动期间播放这些片子。

sentences.en: Just like blurring in your mind.
sentences.zh: 就像在你脑海里模糊成一片。

sentences.en: They're just, you know, a lot of photos being panned across and, like, experts and people being interviewed.
sentences.zh: 就是，你知道，很多照片在镜头前平移，还有专家和受访者。

sentences.en: So, it's sort of a blur of history.
sentences.zh: 所以，这就像是一段模糊的历史。

sentences.en: But I assume that's sort of where I got my idea of what a documentary was in the early part of my life.
sentences.zh: 但我认为这就是我早年对纪录片概念的来源。

sentences.en: And also, I was homeschooled from the sixth grade onwards, which means that, you know, that was a big part of my history understanding was this is, you know, these photographs,
sentences.zh: 而且，我从六年级开始就在家自学，这意味着，你知道，我历史理解的一大部分就是这些照片，

sentences.en: the experts, the firsthand accounts.
sentences.zh: 专家，第一手资料。

sentences.en: That was really what I understood a documentary to be for a long stretch of my youth.
sentences.zh: 那确实是我在青少年时期很长一段时间里对纪录片的理解。

sentences.en: Did you learn a lot about the three tenors from these pledge drives?
sentences.zh: 你从这些募捐活动中了解了很多关于“三大男高音”的事吗？

sentences.en: I did.
sentences.zh: 我了解过。

sentences.en: From Riverdance?
sentences.zh: 还有《大河之舞》？

sentences.en: The three tenors.
sentences.zh: 三大男高音。

sentences.en: Did you learn a great deal about Plogdance?
sentences.zh: 你对“Plogdance”了解很多吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, you know, I don't know.
sentences.zh: 是啊，你知道，我不知道。

sentences.en: I was kind of a pledge drive kid, I guess.
sentences.zh: 我想我算是个募捐活动长大的孩子吧。

sentences.en: How many tote bags does your family have?
sentences.zh: 你家有多少个手提袋？

sentences.en: Oh, we never donated.
sentences.zh: 哦，我们从不捐款。

sentences.en: I just watched the pledge drive.
sentences.zh: 我只是看募捐节目。

sentences.en: I donate now.
sentences.zh: 我现在捐款了。

sentences.en: I donate now.
sentences.zh: 我现在捐款了。

sentences.en: You're giving back.
sentences.zh: 你在回馈社会。

sentences.en: You're giving back.
sentences.zh: 你在回馈社会。

sentences.en: You're giving back through your work.
sentences.zh: 你通过你的工作在回馈社会。

sentences.en: Sucked all this information out of PBS and never gave anything.
sentences.zh: 从PBS吸取了所有这些信息，却从未给予任何回报。

sentences.en: Look, I have so many tote bags now, you don't even know.
sentences.zh: 看，我现在有好多手提袋，你根本想象不到。

sentences.en: I think we all do.
sentences.zh: 我想我们都有。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I'd love to hear more about this perception in your mind of what you thought a documentary was, what it should be, how it should feel.
sentences.zh: 我很想听听你心中对纪录片的看法，你认为它是什么，它应该是什么，它应该是什么感觉。

sentences.en: We're going to talk a little bit more about things that subvert that form.
sentences.zh: 我们待会儿会多谈谈那些颠覆这种形式的作品。

sentences.en: But what did young Alyssa understand a documentary to be?
sentences.zh: 但年轻时的艾丽莎认为纪录片是什么？

sentences.en: Yeah, I think like a lot of people, we think of documentaries as a information-giving vehicle.
sentences.zh: 是的，我想像很多人一样，我们认为纪录片是一种信息传递工具。

sentences.en: You know, it's sort of like a visual magazine article or a visual newspaper article.
sentences.zh: 你知道，它有点像视觉杂志文章或视觉报纸文章。

sentences.en: It's sort of like a visual podcast is almost how I started to think about it.
sentences.zh: 我开始觉得它有点像视觉播客。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Which is like, look at all this information being delivered to me.
sentences.zh: 就像是，看，所有这些信息都在传递给我。

sentences.en: And in fact, you know, Burns often has a book.
sentences.zh: 事实上，你知道，伯恩斯通常会配套一本书。

sentences.en: In fact, I think there's a book that goes with the American Revolution.
sentences.zh: 事实上，我想《美国革命》也有一本书。

sentences.en: There is.
sentences.zh: 确实有。

sentences.en: We just reviewed it at the book review.
sentences.zh: 我们刚在书评栏目评论过它。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: So there's like a book that goes with the documentary.
sentences.zh: 所以有一本书是配合纪录片的。

sentences.en: And so they're kind of, they go hand in hand in their information delivery vehicles.
sentences.zh: 它们相辅相成，都是信息传递工具。

sentences.en: And a lot of us, I think, get that idea because we then, when we're kids, we watch those documentaries in our history classes when our teachers just can't deal with us anymore
sentences.zh: 我想我们很多人都有这种想法，因为当我们还是孩子的时候，当老师实在管不了我们时，我们会在历史课上看那些纪录片，

sentences.en: or for whatever reason, right?
sentences.zh: 或者出于其他原因，对吧？

sentences.en: But it's a good way to learn about history.
sentences.zh: 但这确实是学习历史的好方法。

sentences.en: Certainly, we get the visual images and the ideas.
sentences.zh: 当然，我们得到了视觉图像和观点。

sentences.en: And we get these history clips also from, you know, to understand what did the civil rights movement look like.
sentences.zh: 我们也从这些历史片段中了解民权运动是什么样子的。

sentences.en: It's more exciting than just reading about it in a book.
sentences.zh: 这比仅仅在书本上读到它要令人兴奋得多。

sentences.en: I remember the feel of, you know, being in a wave and being part of something bigger than yourself.
sentences.zh: 我记得那种感觉，置身于浪潮之中，成为比自己更宏大事物的一部分。

sentences.en: And that's a very great feeling.
sentences.zh: 那是一种非常棒的感觉。

sentences.en: Jim, what would you say the reputation of Ken Burns is or the perception?
sentences.zh: 吉姆，你会如何评价肯·伯恩斯的声誉或大众对他的认知？

sentences.en: And do you think that reputation or perception is earned?
sentences.zh: 你认为这种声誉或认知是实至名归的吗？

sentences.en: Or do his documentaries sort of subvert this very basic idea of what Ken Burns is?
sentences.zh: 还是说他的纪录片颠覆了这种关于肯·伯恩斯的基本概念？

sentences.en: Well, I was not always early in my TV critic career and even before then a huge Ken Burns fan.
sentences.zh: 嗯，在我的电视评论生涯早期，甚至在那之前，我并不总是肯·伯恩斯的超级粉丝。

sentences.en: I think I had the perception that maybe a lot of people have that his stuff was very earnest and worthy,
sentences.zh: 我想我当时和很多人一样，认为他的作品非常真诚、有价值，

sentences.en: but very sort of middle of the road.
sentences.zh: 但非常中规中矩。

sentences.en: That it was making an eloquent, well-produced case for things that people already agree on, right?
sentences.zh: 它是在为人们已经达成共识的事情进行雄辩、制作精良的辩护，对吧？

sentences.en: Like, war is hell, you know.
sentences.zh: 比如，战争是地狱，你知道。

sentences.en: Jazz is good.
sentences.zh: 爵士乐很好。

sentences.en: Yes, exactly.
sentences.zh: 是的，完全正确。

sentences.en: You know, we love baseball.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们热爱棒球。

sentences.en: You know, and there is that.
sentences.zh: 你知道，确实如此。

sentences.en: You know, there is a reason that this sort of thing is broadly appealing and, you know, is pledge drive gold.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这种东西之所以具有广泛的吸引力，并且是募捐活动的“黄金”，是有原因的。

sentences.en: But I've also come to see what he does as kind of more pointed and radical over the years than I initially perceived it being, which I think partly is my just growing up
sentences.zh: 但多年来，我也开始看到他所做的事情比我最初认为的更尖锐、更激进，我认为这部分是因为我自己的成长，

sentences.en: and seeing more in it, and partly is maybe a change in the times.
sentences.zh: 看到了更多内涵，部分原因也许是时代变了。

sentences.en: What he is trying to do is sort of create a canon of American history.
sentences.zh: 他试图做的是建立一套美国历史的经典。

sentences.en: You know, whatever we think about the present, we agree, you know, this stuff happened in the past, and it happened for, you know, probably these reasons,
sentences.zh: 你知道，无论我们对现在有什么看法，我们都同意，这些事情在过去发生了，而且发生的原因大概就是这些，

sentences.en: and this is where we came from.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们的由来。

sentences.en: And that is, you know, that it's gotten increasingly contentious over time.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，随着时间的推移，这变得越来越有争议。

sentences.en: I also think that a lot of his documentaries,
sentences.zh: 我也认为他的许多纪录片，

sentences.en: they're really about more than the subject.
sentences.zh: 它们真正讲述的不仅仅是主题本身。

sentences.en: And to me, this is the thing that I come to documentaries for.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，这就是我观看纪录片的原因。

sentences.en: Like, you know, I'm not just trying to get, like, a Wikipedia download of information.
sentences.zh: 我是说，你知道，我不仅仅是想得到一份维基百科式的信息下载。

sentences.en: I want there to be a take, an idea.
sentences.zh: 我希望其中能有一种观点，一个想法。

sentences.en: His National Parks documentary, I remember writing about when it came out somewhere, it was like around the beginning of the Obama administration.
sentences.zh: 我记得他那部关于国家公园的纪录片刚出来的时候，我写过相关的文章，那大概是在奥巴马政府执政初期。
